dedupe_keys.name: kpd gddkia polish national access point for road traffic information

description: KPD is the national access point service of Poland's General Directorate for National Roads and Motorways, implemented under the international CROCODILE and CROCODILE 2 projects. It provides reliable information about traffic conditions nationwide and will in future allow cross-border data exchange through a consistent communication interface. The page lists benefits for different users: road operators get current information about traffic and road works on adjacent networks; service providers reduce the cost of collecting data from road administrators and can create travel information services; the public gets credible information; and emergency services get fast information on difficulties. Coverage: Polish national roads. Format and access: an information platform and interface. Licence and cost: free to consult; terms not stated on the home page. Caveats: details of formats are not given on the home page. It supports network flow and emergency response studies on Polish roads. It relates to the Polish open transport data catalogue, the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: KPD GDDKiA: Polish national access point for road traffic information
provider: General Directorate for National Roads and Motorways (GDDKiA)
